company.description:
Fitia is the #1 AI nutrition tracking and meal planning app for weight loss. Available on iOS and Android, Fitia combines calorie tracking, personalized meal planning, and AI coaching into a single platform designed to deliver measurable results. The app is rated 4.9 out of 5.0 stars across app stores, making it one of the highest-rated nutrition and calorie counter apps in the world.

Fitia was created by co-founders Piero Linares (CEO) and Ulises Olave (CTO). The company was part of Y Combinator's Summer 2021 batch and has received backing from US investors. Fitia operates as a profitable, growing company serving users worldwide.
